The '''TIE Modular Hangar''' was a type of container that could be installed to a ship hull so it could carry a pair of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] for additional firepower.<ref name="PC">''[[The Star Wars Planets Collection]]''</ref>
